mapper.select: SELECT tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at, COUNT(tcm.time_capsule_media_id) AS media_count FROM time_capsule_entry tce LEFT JOIN time_capsule_media tcm ON tcm.time_capsule_entry_id = tce.time_capsule_entry_id AND tcm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tce.time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND tce.status = 'SEALED' GROUP BY tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at ORDER BY tce.contributed_at DESC, tce.time_capsule_entry_id DESC

SELECT tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_capsule_media tcm WHERE tcm.time_capsule_entry_id = tce.time_capsule_entry_id AND tcm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS media_count FROM time_capsule_entry tce INNER JOIN time_capsule tc ON tc.time_capsule_id = tce.time_capsule_id INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = tc.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tce.time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND tce.status != 'DELETED'

SELECT tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_capsule_media tcm WHERE tcm.time_capsule_entry_id = tce.time_capsule_entry_id AND tcm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS media_count FROM time_capsule_entry tce INNER JOIN time_capsule tc ON tc.time_capsule_id = tce.time_capsule_id INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = tc.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tce.time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND tce.author_member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_capsule_media tcm WHERE tcm.time_capsule_entry_id = tce.time_capsule_entry_id AND tcm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS media_count FROM time_capsule_entry tce INNER JOIN time_capsule tc ON tc.time_capsule_id = tce.time_capsule_id INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = tc.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tce.time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND tce.author_member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tce.time_capsule_entry_id, tce.time_capsule_id, tce.author_member_id, tce.account_transaction_id, tce.title, tce.message, tce.contribution_amount, tce.contributed_at, tce.media_mode, tce.thumbnail_object_key, tce.blurred_thumbnail_object_key, tce.status, tce.edit_count, tce.sealed_at, tce.created_at, tce.updated_at, 0 AS media_count FROM time_capsule_entry tce WHERE tce.time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND tce.account_transaction_id = #{accountTransactionId}

SELECT at.account_transaction_id, at.direction, at.amount, at.occurred_at FROM account_transaction at WHERE at.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND at.account_transaction_id = #{accountTransactionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_capsule_entry ( time_capsule_id, author_member_id, account_transaction_id, title, message, contribution_amount, contributed_at, media_mode, status ) VALUES ( #{timeCapsuleId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{accountTransactionId}, #{title}, #{message}, #{contributionAmount}, #{contributedAt}, #{mediaMode}, #{status} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE time_capsule_entry
title = #{title},
message = #{message},
edit_count = edit_count + 1
WHERE time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND edit_count < 1
UPDATE time_capsule_entry SET status = 'SEALED', sealed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE time_capsule_entry SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT time_capsule_entry_id FROM time_capsule_entry WHERE time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_capsule_entry WHERE time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND status = 'SEALED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_capsule_media WHERE time_capsule_entry_id = #{timeCapsuleEntryId} AND status = 'PENDING_UPLOAD'
mapper.update: UPDATE time_capsule SET entry_count = entry_count + 1, total_contribution_amount = total_contribution_amount + #{contributionAmount}, latest_entry_at = CASE WHEN latest_entry_at IS NULL OR latest_entry_at < #{contributedAt} THEN #{contributedAt} ELSE latest_entry_at END WHERE time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND status = 'COLLECTING'
